text:
olivia: Heads-up: launching a docs + SDK quality initiative today. Goal: standardize snippet formats, add CI linting for snippets, and introduce a non-breaking SDK adaptor that opt-in-enforces Structured Output v2 for customers. This is an ops+docs+eng coordinated rollout, no server API changes.

raj: Nice. What are the concrete developer-visible changes?

olivia: Summary:
- snippets: were introducing a canonical snippet schema (snip-v1 -> snip-v2). snip-v1 will be accepted but flagged in CI and docs until sunset.
- SDK adaptor: new flag `output_schema='v2'|None` — default None for 45 days, after which new installs default to 'v2'. adaptor emits client-side warnings when using old snippet tags.
- docs: reorganized "Examples" into language-specific, schema-first pages and added a quick-label on each snippet ("snip-v2" or "legacy").
- CI lint: `docs-lint` will fail on new PRs if a snippet is malformed or missing schema label; we will not block existing branches for 7 days to avoid churn.

kai: Migration help? we should give a tiny recipe and a codemod.

olivia: Migration steps are up on the guide: https://docs.redwood.ai/sdk/snippet-migration. Quick python example: 
```python
# before
resp = client.run("Summarize this" )
# after (snip-v2 explicit)
resp = client.run("Summarize this", output_schema='v2')
```
We also provide a CLI transform and codemod (link on page).

release-bot: release drafted: SDK-adaptor v0.1 (non-breaking), docs reorg deploy queued (deploy-2026-03-23-09).

raj: Ops question: any telemetry or logs we should enable to monitor impact?

olivia: Yes 1) client warnings will be logged to our observability stream (tag: sdk.snippet.warning), 2) docs-lint failure counts on the docs dashboard, 3) well add a small metric for adoption of output_schema='v2'.

security: Any security implications?

olivia: No secrets change. One note: snippet schema restricts serialized metadata; this reduces attack surface from arbitrary exec-like payloads in examples. Security happy with the change.

marco: Support will need a short KB and canned responses. I can draft one if you want.

kai: Please. Also requesting that we add a tiny migration checklist at top of each language page.

olivia: Agreed. Action items:
- docs: add per-language checklist, codemod link, and snippet labels (kai)
- eng: ship adaptor, expose client warning metric, and keep default None for 45 days (raj)
- release: coordinate external blog + changelog (olivia + release-bot)
- support: KB + canned replies (marco)

olivia: Timeline: today - docs deploy + draft adaptor; 7 days - enable docs-lint on new PRs only; 45 days - change new-installs default to output_schema='v2' but continue support for legacy installs; 90 days - revisit sunset plan based on telemetry.

raj: I'll open the adaptor PR and ping this thread when ready.

marco: Will prepare KB and post draft in #support later today.

olivia: Thanks everyone. Please escalate if you see widespread false positives in the lint. :sparkles:
